articles.summary: This release introduces Intelligent Inventory Merchandising, Ekho’s AI system that automatically matches and enriches dealer inventory to power autonomous titling and registration. By identifying, normalizing, and merchandising vehicles—even with inconsistent source data—the platform eliminates manual inventory mapping, accelerates onboarding, and improves vehicle discovery. Dealers benefit from faster processing and better search performance, while buyers experience a smoother path from research to road-ready.
articles.title: Intelligent Inventory Merchandising is Live
